enemyConfigurations.name: Out of Control Sky Pole - Yi

out_of_control_sky_pole_yi.name: Out of Control Sky Pole - Yi
out_of_control_sky_pole_yi.flavourText: UAV-type comprehensive monitoring-maintenance system on experimental plates, Sky Pole Model Yi. Originally capable of completing tasks within the signal range of Model Jia, such as collecting crop samples, eliminating pests, spraying pesticides, and driving away trespassing beasts. However, it has now gone out of control.
abilities: Latches onto the first unit within range and relentlessly attacks until the target is defeated

expelled_filth.name: Expelled Filth
expelled_filth.flavourText: A fabric construct born from the farmers' fears of a failed harvest. They carry a wide range of crop-killing Blights, and pose a tremendous risk to agricultural yields.
abilities: Causes Blight to the paddy when defeated

banished_consumption.name: Banished Consumption
banished_consumption.flavourText: A fabric construct that corrodes plants, capable of spraying highly hazardous Blight from a distance. Even well-protected crops on agricultural plates are at risk.
abilities: When on Blighted tiles, attacks deal Arts damage

accursed_scum.name: Accursed Scum
accursed_scum.flavourText: A gargantuan fabric construct that uses its huge mass and nigh-impenetrable skin to wreak havoc across the paddies, loathed by farmers.
abilities: Causes heavy Blight to the paddy when defeated

basal_miasma.name: Basal Miasma
basal_miasma.flavourText: Similar to a stockbeast in appearance, seemingly docile at first glance. But unlike other fabric constructs, they become very aggressive towards people after absorbing the Blight in the soil and water, so exercise the utmost caution.
abilities: Regenerates itself on the spot when defeated, continuously absorbing any Blight it is in contact with and increasing DEF based on the amount absorbed; attacks now deal additional Arts damage

renounced_blemish.name: Renounced Blemish
renounced_blemish.flavourText: A fabric construct that ruthlessly spreads Blight across a wide area. If left unchecked, once fertile farmland will instantly become a farmer's worst nightmare.
abilities: Absorbs shallow water to attack all allied melee units on the map, dealing splash damage in a cross
When on Blighted tiles, attacks deal additional Arts damage and causes Blight to the paddy

slumbering_of_sui.name: 'Slumbering of Sui'
slumbering_of_sui.flavourText: Born from the heart of an awakened Feranmut. A thousand years twisted into shadow. The executors of Sui are never alone, for fear is always by their side; to wait in the boundless chaos, or thread the needle in search for a shred of enlightenment?
abilities: Molts after taking a certain amount of damage, causing Blight to the paddies it is on, reducing ATK, DEF, RES, and Weight, while increasing Movement Speed
When HP drops to 0 for the first time, melts into the water and continuously summons enemies; enters the Enlightened State when reborn
Changes attributes, attacks now deal 2 strikes of Physical damage, and becomes immune to most control effects
Marks all allied units that have attacked 'Slumbering of Sui'; when a marked unit leaves the field, causes extremely high level of Blight to the tiles where 'Slumbering of Sui' is on

[As Needlework] When the Blight level of a paddy at this unit's location exceeds a certain threshold, 'Slumbering of Sui' will continuously absorb and condense Blight into a spear that deals a large amount of Arts damage, prioritizing marked Operators
'Slumbering of Sui' has reduced DEF, RES, and Movement Speed when it is on paddies unaffected by Blight, or when scoured with unpolluted water.
